d.d: simple past and past participle of jelly
third-person singular simple present indicative of jelly
A dessert made by boiling gelatine, sugar and some flavoring (often derived from fruit) and allowing it to set.
A dessert made by boiling gelatin in water.
A dessert made by boiling gelatine (or a plant-based alternative such as agar or carrageenan), sugar and some flavouring (often derived from fruit) and allowing it to set.
d.x: His mother prepared jelly for him and his friends for dessert.

d.d: A clear or translucent fruit preserve, made from fruit juice and set using either naturally occurring, or added, pectin.
An almost transparent aquatic animal; any one of the acalephs, especially one of the larger species, having a jellylike appearance.

Any of various species of cnidarians in the subphylum Medusozoa, including box jellyfish (class Cubozoa), true jellyfish (class Scyphozoa), stalked jellyfish (class Staurozoa), and certain hydrozoans.
The medusa phase of these animals rather than a younger life stage.
